description.value:
Cost: 1,000eb

A heavy boot covering the foot and shin. Contains 2 option slots for cyberleg options. When worn, the options in the boot's slots can be accessed. Putting on the Battleboot and taking it off is an Action. Any options stored in a Cyberleg or meat leg the Battleboot is covering are inaccessible while the Battleboot is being worn. Cannot be concealed.

Type: Cyberleg (Foundational)
Option Slots: provides 2

Foundry notes:

  • Built like the core Battleglove, as Cyberleg cyberware with 2 slots, so cyberleg options can be installed in it. Equipping it takes an Action. Options in the leg it covers are not disabled automatically.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Weapons).
